test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a company, there are only two types of employees: workers and officers. The average monthly salary of an officer is ₹78,000 more than the combined average monthly salary of an employee, while the combined average monthly salary of an employee is ₹42,000 more than the average monthly salary of a worker. What percentage of all the employees are officers?
solution:
**Given:**

Average monthly salary of an officer = Rs 78,000 more than the combined average monthly salary of an employee.

Combined average monthly salary of an employee = Rs 42,000 more than the average monthly salary of a worker

**Calculation:**

Let the average monthly salary of workers be x

According to the question,&
lt;/p>

Average monthly salary of an employee = 42000 + x

Average monthly salary of an officer = 78000 + (42000 + x) = 120000 + x

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1f6dfb6c02aeb9328797e082945399165907832dad694fdf92f0b8482a3139a.png] 

So,

Officers : Workers = 21 : 39

Percentage of all the employees who are officers = (21)/(21+39) × 100 = 35%

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**
